verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a remote MCP server that AI agents such as Claude, Cursor and Copilot can use, plus a one-command CLI to connect it to AI clients. It also publishes llms.txt and markdown docs so agents like Codex can scaffold sign-in, sessions and orgs. However, the MCP server only exposes SDK snippets and implementation patterns, so natural language helps write integration code rather than run the product itself (users, orgs, settings). Missing for 10: natural-language or agent tools that operate Clerk resources directly (users, orgs, config, dashboard actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven workflows.
